description: SASRec predicts the next item using causal self-attention over interaction histories. Item and learned positional embeddings pass through attention and feed-forward blocks; the final history representation scores candidate item embeddings. Attention can emphasize recent interactions or retrieve longer-range dependencies. Source: [Self-Attentive Sequential Recommendation](https://arxiv.org/html/1808.09781v1).
motivation: The paper balances the simplicity of short-range Markov models with the expressive history modeling of recurrent networks. For this task, SASRec supplies the starting architecture. The supplied description specifies a benchmark setup rather than a new cold-start technique; standard SASRec does not directly solve recommendation for items without training interactions.
implementation_notes: Start from RecHarness sasrec_perdataset and retain independent routing for Movies_and_TV, Industrial_and_Scientific, Electronics, and CDs_and_Vinyl. Preserve preprocessing seed 0, training seed 42, DATA_DIR = os.environ['GAGC_DATA_DIR'], and the effective SASREC_EPOCHS default of 200. Train using shifted sequences, causal and padding masks, and sampled positive/negative binary cross-entropy. Select configurations only by host macro validation HR@10 under the fixed evaluation protocol. Store artifacts beneath the trial directory, keep execution single-GPU, and charge all trials against the shared 43,200 GPU-second budget. Architecture changes must update the predictor writer and DiagnosisProbe compatibility contract. No benchmark improvement has been established here.
pseudocode:
for category in four_categories:
    load unchanged training split with preprocessing seed 0
    initialize category SASRec with training seed 42
    for epoch in configured_epochs(default=200):
        for sequence, positive, negative in training_batches:
            features = causal_SASRec(item_embedding(sequence) + position_embedding)
            loss = masked_BCE(features·embedding(positive), 1)
                 + masked_BCE(features·embedding(negative), 0)
            update_parameters(loss)
    save category model and architecture configuration beneath trial directory
write working/predict.py with matching architecture and category routing
select trial using host macro validation HR@10

originality.positive: Scores use a 1–10 scale. The original paper introduced a clear application of self-attention to sequential recommendation.
originality.negative: Reusing SASRec in this task adds little methodological novelty; no distinct cold-start mechanism is described.

future_potential.positive: Public titles and descriptions could support a future content-aware extension for sparse items.
future_potential.negative: That extension is outside the original SASRec method and requires validation within the remaining search budget.

code_difficulty.positive: Higher scores mean greater implementation difficulty. The existing SASRec baseline already supplies most required components.
code_difficulty.negative: Masking, padding, predictor serialization, category routing, and diagnostic compatibility still require care.
